name: x-post-drafts
description: 5 X/Twitter post drafts in the user's voice from a topic (drafts only, never posted)

voice.default: direct, concise, first person, no hype, no hashtags spam

goal: Write 5 X post drafts about: {topic}. Voice: {voice}.
constraints: Drafts only: do NOT post, schedule, or contact anyone; no credentials are available. Each draft <= 280 characters, distinct angle, no invented facts or stats. Write drafts.md with the 5 numbered drafts and their character counts.
done_when: drafts.md contains exactly 5 numbered drafts, each <= 280 characters with its count, all on the topic and in the requested voice.
